cases.sentence: К Илии было слово Господа, уходи отсюда, поверни на восток и спрячься у реки ___, что к востоку от Иордана.
cases.translation: Yahweh's word came to Elijah: Leave here and go east and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, which is east of the Jordan
cases.explain: The preposition у (by/at) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Вороны приносили ему хлеб и мясо утром и вечером, а пил он из ___.
cases.translation: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning and evening, and he drank from the brook
cases.explain: The preposition из (from, out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Когда он подошел к воротам города, там была вдова, которая собирала ___.
cases.translation: When he came to the gate of the city, a widow was there gathering wood
cases.explain: The transitive verb собирала (gathering) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: «У меня нет хлеба, лишь пригоршни муки в катке да немного масла в ___.
cases.translation: I don't have any bread, just a handful of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location uses the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Она пошла и сделала так, как сказал ей Илия, и каждый день у нее, у Илии и у ее семьи была ___.
cases.translation: She went and did as Elijah had told her, and day after day she, Elijah, and her family had food
cases.explain: The noun is the subject of была (was), so it takes nominative case.

cases.sentence: Он положил его на ___. Затем он возвал Господу.
cases.translation: He laid him on his bed. Then he cried out to the Lord
cases.explain: The transitive verb положил (laid) takes accusative.

cases.sentence: Илия взял мальчика и отнес его вниз из своей комнаты в ___. Он отдал его матери.
cases.translation: Elijah took the child and brought him down from his room into the house and gave him to his mother
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) with direction uses accusative.

cases.sentence: Женщина сказала Илии, 'Теперь я знаю, что ты ___ Божий, и что слово Господа, сказанное тобой, истинно'.
cases.translation: The woman said to Elijah, 'Now I know that you are a man of God'
cases.explain: In the predicate nominative construction, the noun takes nominative case.

reading.ru: Илия истишь бы, что в Галааде, сказал Ахаву. Верно, как и то, что жив Господь, Бог Израиля, которому я служу. В эти годы не будет ни росы, ни дождя, разве только по моему слову.
reading.question: What drought did Elijah predict to King Ahab?
options: There would be no dew or rain except by his word
reading.correct: There would be no dew or rain except by his word
reading.explain: Elijah declared there would be neither dew nor rain except by his word.

reading.ru: Вороны приносили ему хлеб и мясо утром и вечером, а пил он из реки.
reading.question: How did God provide for Elijah while he was hiding at the brook?
options: Ravens brought him bread and meat morning and evening, and he drank from the brook
He gathered his own food from the land
reading.correct: Ravens brought him bread and meat morning and evening, and he drank from the brook
reading.explain: The text describes the ravens bringing him provisions.

reading.ru: Когда он подошел к воротам города, там была вдова, которая собирала дрова.
reading.question: What was the widow doing when Elijah met her at the city gate?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states the widow was gathering wood.

reading.ru: «У меня нет хлеба, лишь пригоршни муки в катке да немного масла в кувшине.'
reading.question: What was the widow's situation when Elijah asked her for help?
options: She had only a handful of flour and a little oil
reading.correct: She had only a handful of flour and a little oil
reading.explain: The widow described her scarcity: only a handful of flour and little oil.

reading.ru: Мука в катке не переводилась, и масло в кувшине не кончалось, по слову Господа, сказанному Илией.
reading.question: What miracle did God perform in the widow's house during the famine?
options: Her jar of flour and jug of oil never ran out according to Elijah's word
God sent rain to her house
Her son was healed from an illness
God multiplied her fields of grain
reading.correct: Her jar of flour and jug of oil never ran out according to Elijah's word
reading.explain: The flour and oil never failed, fulfilling Elijah's word.

reading.ru: Через некоторое время сын той женщины, хозяйки дома, заболел. Ему становилось все хуже и хуже, и, наконец, он перестал дышать.
reading.question: What serious problem occurred in the widow's household?
options: Her son became sick and stopped breathing
She ran out of food and water
reading.correct: Her son became sick and stopped breathing
reading.explain: The text describes how the widow's son became progressively ill and eventually stopped breathing.
